summary: 🥔 Survive the alien horde! Equip 6 weapons at once in this roguelite shooter.
description:
Blast through alien hordes as Brotato, the only potato capable of wielding 6 weapons simultaneously! 

You are the last hope on a hostile planet. Stranded and outnumbered, you must battle relentless waves of aliens, scavenge materials, and craft unique builds to survive until rescue arrives. Can you hold out against the endless swarm?

Each run lasts just 20–30 minutes, delivering thrilling, fast-paced roguelite action perfect for quick mobile sessions. Build your strategy with dozens of traits and hundreds of items—and see how far you can survive!

【KEY FEATURES】
⚔️ SIX-WEAPON FRENZY: Wield up to 6 weapons at once with default auto-firing or precision manual aiming.
⏱️ FAST-PACED ACTION: Quick, intense runs designed to be completed in under 30 minutes.
🎭 DIVERSE CHARACTERS: Choose from a wide range of traits—from One-Armed and Crazy to Lucky and Mage—to create your unique build.
🛠️ INFINITE BUILDS: Experiment with hundreds of items and weapons, including flamethrowers, SMGs, rocket launchers, and even sticks & stones!
🌊 SURVIVAL WAVES: Survive 20 to 90-second waves and collect materials to level up and gear up in the shop.

⚠️ NOTE: Cloud saving is available only while online. You can play offline, but your progress will not be synced to the cloud without an internet connection.
